t: Beereb pesach achar shaa asirit asur leekol pat
s: Beereb pesach achar shaa asirit asur leekol pat ubo y"d seipim: kol adam, ap sheeno istenis — asur lo leekol pat, dehaynu matztza ashira (kemo sheyyitbaer) mittechillat shaa asirit beereb pesach ad hallayla, kede sheyyokal matztza ballayla leteabon, uben shehayyom arok uben shehayyom qatzar — leolam asur lo leekol mittechillat rebia yom haacharon ad hallayla. Vaapillu lehatchil qodem shaa asirit asur, im yodea shettimshok seudato ad tok shaa asirit:

Abal muttar leekol meat perot o meat yeraqot, ben chayyin ben mebushshalin, o meat tabshil heasuy mechameshet hamminim shennitbashshelu beme perot lehannohagin hetter beme perot, o meat basar vedagim ugebina ubetzim, veken shear kol hamminin, shello aseru ella pat bilbad shessoedet et halleb, shenneemar "velechem lebab enosh yisad". Umikkol maqom, lo hittiru mishshear hamminim ella meat, abal lo yemalle kereso mehen. Veken yakol lishtot kol hammashqin, chutz miyyayin, shello yishteh mimmennu meat, mippene shehu soed et halleb kemo pat, abal harbeh yayin yakol lishtot, mippene shekkeshehu shoteh harbeh mimmennu — hu gorer taavat hammaakal. Umikkol maqom, lo yishteh harbeh kol kak ad sheyyehe sabea, ki bevadday hu meqalqel taavat hammaakal:
Mi shehu istenis sheap keshehu okel meat bayyom mishshaa asirit vaelak lo yukal leekol ballayla leteabon — asur lo leekol apillu meat mishshear kol hamminim:

Qodem shaa asirit muttar leekol pat al derek shennitbaer besiman rm"t. Umah hi happat sheyyokal? Shehare chametz eno yakol leekol mishshaa chamishit vaelak, umatztza eno yakol leekol kol hayyom meammud hashshachar vaelak, sheameru chakamim: kol haokel matztza beereb pesach — keillu boel arusato bebet chamiv qodem sheyyaknisenna lachuppa lebarek aleha sheba berakot, umakkin oto makkat mardut. Ha eno yakol leekol ella matztza ashira, dehaynu sheereb bah me perot, shello aseru chakamim leekol beereb pesach ella matztza sheadam yakol latzet bah yede chobato ballayla, abal matztza ashira en yotzein bah kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"b, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:
Enah niqret matztza ashira ella im ken taam hamme perot nirgash bammatztza, abal im ereb bah meat me perot veen taman nirgash bah — enah niqret matztza ashira, veasur leoklah beereb pesach:
Vekol zeh bimqomot shennohagin laasot matztza ashira, abal kebar nitbaer besiman ts"b shebbimdinot ellu en nohagin kelal laasot matztza ashira, ayyen sham hattaam:

Matztza kepula o nepucha shennitbaer besiman ts"a sheoserin otah baakila bepesach missapeq shemma nitchammetza — ap al pi ken asur leoklah beereb pesach apillu qodem shaa chamishit, sheyyesh lachosh shemma lo nitchammetza umatztza gemura hi, veasur leekol matztza beereb pesach:

Matztza shenneepet ketiqqunah veachar kak nitporera ben bemayim ben bishar mashqim ume perot venitbashshela, ap al pi shehapperusot qayyamot beinyan shemmebarekin alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, ap al pi ken muttar leoklah beereb pesach qodem shaa asirit, shehare en adam yakol latzet bah yede chobato ballayla, kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"a. Veim en happerusot qayyamot, dehaynu sheen mehem kezayit beinyan shemmebarekin alehem "bore mine mezonot" umeen shalosh — muttar leoklan ap mishshaa asirit ulemala, kevan sheen alehem torat pat kelal leinyan beraka. Matztza shenneepet ketiqqunah veachar kak nitporera apillu leperurin daqqin meod — asur leekol happerurin beereb pesach, veadam yotze bah yede chobato bepesach, sheadayin torat lechem alehem lekol dabar, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch:

Veim chazar velash et happerurin hallalu beyayin veshemen ushear mashqin ume perot, velo bishshelan velo tiggenan achar kak — yesh lehistappeq im hi niqret matztza ashira. Ki yesh lomar: kevan shekkebar neepet beoni ap sheachar kak nitashshera, ap al pi ken ani qore lah "lechem oni", shebbeshaa shennaaset "lechem", dehaynu bishat apiyya, hayeta be"oni". O yesh lomar: kevan shennitporera veachar kak chazar velash otah beme perot — hare nishtannet mimmah shehayeta venipqa mimmenna shemah harishon venaaset matztza ashira. Lepikak yesh lehachamir shello latzet bah yede choba bepesach, ki shemma hi matztza ashira, vegam shello leoklah beereb pesach, ki shemma enah matztza ashira:

Qatan o qetanna sheenan yodein mah shemmesapperim lahen bitziat mitzrayim — muttar lehaakilam matztza beereb pesach kol hayyom, vaapillu ballayla qodem qiddush, mittaam shennitbaer besiman shm"g. Veap al pi sheasur lehaakil haqqatan beyadayim debarim haasurin, apillu enan asurin ella middibre soperim, mikkol maqom debarim sheenan asurim mechamat atzman ella shehu zeman issur, kegon matztza beereb pesach, o leekol qodem qiddush — muttar lehaakilam beyadayim im hem tzerikin lekak, kemo shemmuttar lehaakilam beyadayim beyom hakkippurim, veen meannin otam apillu yekolin lisbol hattaanit. Abal qatan uqetanna sheyyesh bahem daat lehabin mah shemmesapperim lahem bitziat mitzrayim ballayla kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"[b] — asur lehaakilam beereb pesach, shehare neemar "vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu lemor baabur zeh asa veku'", "baabur zeh", haynu matztza umaror hammunnachim lepaneka, veim hattinoq mille kereso mimmatztza — haek shayyak lomar lo "baabur zeh":

Yesh nohagin shello leekol maror beereb pesach, kede sheyyoklennu ballayla leteabon. Veken shello leekol beyom rishon shel pesach, kede leoklo belel sheni leteabon. Veken nohagin qetzat bene adam lemaet baakilat matztza beyom rishon, kede leoklo belel sheni leteabon:

Abal yesh nohagin lehachamir od shello leekol perot beereb pesach o beyom rishon shel pesach, kede leekol charoset ballayla leteabon. Veen lachosh lamminhag hahu, ki hacharoset en mitzva leoklo ella kede lebattel haeres shebbammaror shello yazziqennu, veadderabba asur leekol harbeh mimmenu im hammaror, vetzarik lenappetzo meal hammaror shello yebattel taam hammaror, veim ken lamma lo yokal perot bo bayyom?

Yesh nohagin lehachamir shello leshabber o leparer hammatztzot beereb pesach, shemma yishkach veyokal mehen. Vegam leminhag zeh en lachosh, dekevan sheeno ragil bematztza kol hashshana — en chosheshin shemma yishkach veyokal. Veod, dekevan sheissur akilat matztza beereb pesach eno ella middibre soperim — en machamirin bo kol kak:

Im hitchil leekol matztza ashira qodem shaa asirit — en tzarik lehapsiq keshettaggia shaa asirit, ella yakol limshok seudato ad hallayla, dehaynu ad ben hashshemashot shehu sepeq chasheka, sheaz tzarik lehapsiq seudato. Veen tzarik lebarek birkat hammazon miyyad, ella yamtin ad sheyyihyeh vadday chasheka mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman ta"b, veaz yipros mappa al hashshulchan lekassot happat ad leachar qiddush mittaam shennitbaer besiman ra"a, veyomar qiddush hayyom al kos rishon, velo yebarek alayv kevan shehu omed beemtza hasseuda, veachar kak yomar hahaggada al kos sheni, vegam ken lo yebarek alayv (ulepi minhag medinot ellu sheyyitbaer besiman ta"d tzarik lebarek ben al kos rishon ben al kos sheni, mittaam sheyyitbaer sham), veachar kak yebarek "al akilat matztza" al "lechem oni", veen tzarik lebarek "hammotzi", kevan shehu beemtza hasseuda velo hissiach dato kelal mehaakila, kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besiman ra"a:
